subject.title: Feature: Add maxTurns/maxToolCalls config option to limit agent iterations

question: Should OpenClaw accept a default-off global/per-agent hard iteration budget contract for agent tool-calling rounds, and which public config names, budget unit, unsupported-harness behavior, and exhaustion result should become the release contract?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but adding strict agent config and agent-loop semantics creates a public runtime contract that automation should not finalize without maintainer product intent.

options.title: Settle and land the active budget PR
options.body: Use the active candidate to finalize config names, defaults, unsupported-harness behavior, and budget-exhausted results before closing this issue.

options.title: Redesign the budget contract
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define a different contract covering turns, tool calls, and timeout-after-first-tool behavior.

options.title: Decline core budget limits
options.body: Close this and associated budget requests only if maintainers decide existing loop detection and model choice are the supported path.

recommendation.title: Settle and land the active budget PR
recommendation.body: Use the active candidate to finalize config names, defaults, unsupported-harness behavior, and budget-exhausted results before closing this issue.
